stem.text: A sample of gas is sealed in a cylinder by a piston. The frictionless piston is free to move, so that the pressure of the gas remains constant at $1.80 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Pa}$.
The gas initially occupies a volume of $2.40 \times 10^{-4}\,\text{m}^{3}$.
The gas now does $14.4\,\text{J}$ of work.
What is the volume of the gas after doing this work?
